declaration.evidence_label: E-MAX DEVELOPMENT (reused development data; not OOS)
declaration.question: With R1 ordering fixed, does spreading the same normalized session exposure over up to five H5 candidates instead of three help?

dataset.binding: the E-R2 / E-R3 / M1 development binding, unchanged (tape d12ff28a98cf9cc6..., USB-HIST-V1, 480 sessions 2024-10-16..2026-09-16)
dataset.prechecks: re-run through app.backtest.strategy_e_max.prepare before any return

variants.ordering: premarket_rvol descending; tie symbol ascending (app.strategy_e_max.ranking R1)
variants.selection: first max_selected of the R1 order; selection before entry validation; replacement NONE (candidate #6 is never promoted)
forbidden: any other ordering, including re-selecting R2 or R3
H5, entry, exit, stop, target, cost, exposure or breadth changes
symbol exclusion (ABSI, HIMS or any other)

execution.implementation: app.strategy_e_max.capacity.execute: selected symbols in canonical chunks of <= 3 through E-D2 build_entry_records and E-D3 resolve_exit_batch unchanged; E-D5 _classification unchanged; equal weight 1/n over executable positions; E-D4 apply_cost unchanged
execution.entry: exact 09:30 ET open; invalid -> ENTRY_INVALID (NO_TRADE_*), no backfill
execution.exit: exact 09:34 ET close; fallback NONE; invalid -> UNRESOLVED_EXIT / INVALID_FOR_STANDARD_PNL
execution.sizing: normalized active-session gross exposure 1.0 for both C1 and C2 (1/3, 1/4, 1/5 ... per executable position); exposure is not increased
execution.c1_reproduction: C1 through capacity.execute must hash to the committed M1 R1 artifacts (trades and daily returns) before C2 is read

risk_status.c2: RESEARCH ONLY; NOT LIVE AUTHORIZED; NOT COMMON-RISK COMPLIANT
risk_status.consequence: an M2 PASS changes no risk contract; a separate aggressive risk contract must be preregistered before any integrated E-MAX candidate could trade

improvement.paired: delta_t = C2 - C1 COST_10BP session return, all 480 sessions (no-trade sessions 0); metrics.bootstrap_mean_ci, IID, 10,000 replicates, seed 20260921

winner.rule: C2 passing every eligibility and improvement condition -> MAX5 SELECTED; otherwise NO_USEFUL_ENHANCEMENT and C1 carries to M3

opportunity: sessions whose selected set changes from C1 to C2
diagnostics.stop_b: CAGR ratio = C2 CAGR / C1 CAGR; MDD ratio = |C2 MDD| / |C1 MDD|; flagged when the MDD ratio exceeds the CAGR ratio (M0 stop B); diagnostic only
diagnostics.blocks: E-D6 four blocks: session mean, trades, compounded block return
diagnostics.interpretation_limit: capacity can only matter on sessions with >= 4 candidates, almost all in the broad-coverage period (block 4); a PASS means max 5 beat the frozen max-3 comparator in development exploration, not that E-MAX is statistically validated

reproducibility.required: identical result digest and byte-identical runtime artifacts
